purpose: Match the supplied combat board's material language, battle camera, and environmental composition in the standalone game.

assets.prompt: Edit this sprite sheet for engine-ready layout. Keep the EXACT four characters' appearance, materials, colors, camera angles and identity. Background must remain actual transparent alpha. Reposition and scale the four characters into FOUR COMPLETELY SEPARATE equal-width cells in one horizontal row: Reaver, Herald, Rogue, Starseer. Each cell must have clear empty transparent vertical gutters at its left and right, at least 30 pixels. All weapons, cloaks, hats, staff and extremities must remain strictly inside the character's own cell, with no overlap into neighboring cell. Especially Reaver's sword must NOT enter Herald's column; turn the sword downward slightly to fit. Keep the ENTIRE figures, weapons and feet visible. Each head near same upper line and feet near same lower line. Tall fullbody figures, landscape sprite atlas with four equal-width columns. No scenery, no ground, no shadows across neighboring cells, no labels, no panels. True transparency, not a painted background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for AshenSpire dark fantasy videogame. Reference image is STYLE / MATERIAL / CAMERA reference only (combat board). Create ONE landscape image divided implicitly into FOUR EQUAL WIDTH columns, each containing ONE different full-body adventurer. Left to right: 1 Reaver knight in battered blackened plate with burgundy ragged cape, enclosed steel helmet, straight sword held diagonally down and forward and shield; 2 Herald in weathered ivory gold robes and enclosed hood, round shield and mace; 3 Rogue in dark worn leather hooded cloak holding paired daggers; 4 Starseer in charcoal layered robes pointed weathered wizard hat, staff tipped with dim amber star. EVERY adventurer viewed three-quarter FROM BEHIND, facing toward RIGHT, battle-ready stance planted on invisible ground, like hero on far left of reference combat scene. Realistic anatomy and detailed painterly gritty material, NO cartoon outlines, NO white edge outlines. Warm ember rim lighting from right, cool soft sky fill. NO chibi, no pixel art, no toy/plastic/lowpoly. Transparent background alpha, no ground, no shadows beyond small contact shadow, no environment, no UI, no writing. All four figures fully visible, heads same top level, feet same bottom baseline, distinct nonoverlapping equal-width regions separated by transparent margin. Weapons must fit within their own columns. High quality lifelike dark fantasy oil illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent ENEMY sprite sheet for AshenSpire dark fantasy game. Reference is STYLE MATERIAL and combat camera reference only. Landscape canvas, THREE EQUAL WIDTH columns completely separated by transparent space. Left column: one full-body wandering hollow soldier in pitted medieval dark iron plate and hood, broken shield left hand and low pointed sword, facing LEFT in three-quarter front battle stance. Middle column: one full-body gaunt blight hound, quadrupedal wolf silhouette, black burned fur with restrained glowing amber cracks, bared teeth facing LEFT, all four paws visible. Right column: one full-body Charred Colossus, hulking monumental jagged volcanic rock armor giant, molten orange seams, small sunken head and enormous stone gauntlets, facing LEFT in 3/4 front battle stance. Beautiful painterly realism, weathered gritty believable materials, sharp readable silhouettes, cinematic natural warm side light and gray skylight. No illustration outlines, no white fringes, no cartoon or toy style, no flat vector or lowpoly. Transparent alpha background absolutely no scenery/UI/text. Entire each character and equipment visible, no clipping, each inside its own equal-width column with generous margin, common ground baseline near lower edge, soldier and colossus occupy similar sheet height (runtime will scale), hound body height about half sheet height. No labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production background only for playable tactical combat in AshenSpire. Reference is desired painterly realistic dark-fantasy environment and composition. Make a single very wide cinematic landscape view of a crumbling gothic castle courtyard, broken arches and cathedral towers framing sides, distant colossal spire at upper center-right, hazy bronze sunset with pale sun behind clouds. Wet dark cobblestone battlefield occupies bottom 55 percent with detailed depth perspective, small scattered rubble at edges, ruined low walls midground, tiny ember braziers far edges. Smoky ash gray and weathered soot brown, restrained warm sunset gold, NOT green tinted. Eye-level tactical side-view camera slightly raised, open horizontal floor for character sprites. Rich lived-in painterly realism consistent with combat reference. Empty environment: absolutely NO characters, monsters, text, interface, cards, borders, labels. Lower third floor is calm and dark so live card UI remains readable. Full bleed 16:9 landscape.

runtime: Original PNG pixels and alpha are preserved. src/visual-atlas.json supplies measured frame bounds for Phaser and SVG viewports. Backgrounds use uniform cover scaling.
